description:
Estimate whether a household is likely to get free or discounted care at one facility, or at each facility near a zip.
Use it when a person asks if their income is low enough for free or reduced-cost care, charity care, or a discount on a hospital bill.
Takes household size (people in the home, including the patient), yearly household income before taxes, state, and a facility id or zip.
Returns income as a percent of the poverty level, the result per facility (likely_free, likely_discount, likely_not, unknown), the dollar income cutoffs for this household size, and next steps.
Results are estimates from published rules. The hospital makes the final decision, and asset tests, residency rules, and insurance status can change the answer.
"unknown" means there are no income limits on file for that facility, not that help is unavailable.

annual_income.description: Yearly household income before taxes, in US dollars.

facility_id.description: Facility id from find_facilities. Use this or zip.

household_size.description: Number of people in the household, including the patient.

kind.description: hospital, health_center (community health centers with sliding fees), or any.

state.description: The patient's state (sets the poverty table: AK and HI differ).

zip.description: Check every facility near this zip instead of one facility.
